DOP: āpāna n. [ ts ], drinking; a drinking party; a place for drinking ; Abh 534; Ja I 268, 24 (~aṃ sajjetvā nisīditvā); Dhp-a III 357, 19 (aho amhākaṃ ñātakānaṃ gehaṃ catuddisāhi āgatāgatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ °-bhūtan ti ādīni vatvā pasaṃsaṃ pavatteti, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Se opānabhūtan ti); — °- bhūmi , f. , a drinking-place, a drinking-booth; a tavern ; Ja I 269, 3 ; V 292, 1 ; Vism 399, 6 (Nandopanandassa ~iṃ sajjayiṃsu); Dhp-a I 213, 20 (rañño ~iṃ na pavisāmī ti); — °- maṇḍala , n. , an enclosed place for drinking ; Ja I 52, 20 (sakalaṃ Lumbinivanaṃ … rañño susajjita-āpānamaṇḍalaṃ viya ahosi) = Ap-a 57, 8 ; Ja I 269, 7 ; Ps II 372, 22 .
CPD: āpāna-bhūmi , f . [ ts .], a place for drinking in company; a tavern, liquor-shop; nom. sg. ~i micchā- diṭṭhiyuvatīnaṃ, Att lV 3; acc. sg. tesaṃ ~iṃ gantvā tesaṃ kiriyaṃ oloketvā 'ayaṃ surā imehi iminā nāma kāraṇena yojitā' ti ñatvā, Ja l 269, 3 ; setac- chattaṃ ~iñ ca vatthaṃ gahetvā, Ja V 292, 1 ; attano anurūpehi katakaṇṇapilandhanehi samannāgate ~iṃ sajjetvā nisinne surāsoṇḍe ca, Ja Vl 276, 29 ; rañño ~iṃ na pavisāmi, Dhp-a l 213, 20 ; Nandopanandassa ~iṃ sajjayiṃsu, Vism 399, 6 (yattha so nisinno bhoja- nakiccaṃ karoti, taṃ parivesanaṭṭhānaṃ sītasa- maṭṭhaṃ bhojanupakāraṇupanayanâdinā sajjayiṃsu paṭiyādesuṃ, Vism-mhṭ S e ll 287, 12-14 ); yathā-vi- bhavaṃ ~iṃ sajjetvā bhuñjantā pivantā, Ud-a 365, 12 ( v. l. āpaṇa°); manussānaṃ ~iṃ ( v. l. ~i-) ramanīyesu mahāpariḷāhesu, ib. 365, 21 ; loc. sg. uda- kakīḷaṃ kīḷitvā uyyānaṃ gantvā ~iyaṃ nisīdi, Dhp-a lll 79, 15 ; mātugāme gahetvā ~iyaṃ nisinne (katvā), Ps ll 418, 29 ; āmutta-maṇi-kuṇḍale sajjitāya ~iyā nisinnavasen' eva, Spk l 152, 1 ; — ° sadisa , mfn., like a place for drinking; n. vanantaṃ . . . ~aṃ miga- pakkhikānaṃ, Samantak 745.
